headline: Parker to Announce Fiscal 2026 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Earnings on August 6; Conference Call and Webcast Scheduled for 11 a.m. Eastern
summary: CLEVELAND, July 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Parker Hannifin Corporation (NYSE: PH), the global leader in motion and control technologies, today announced that it will release its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter and full year earnings before the market opens on Thursday, August 6, 2026, followed by a conference call at 11:00 a.m., Eastern time. During the call, the company will discuss fiscal 2026 fourth quarter and full year results and respond to questions from institutional investors and security
